Permissions required by samples/access-reviews.entra.json (mode: delegated, 6 resource(s))

Microsoft Graph delegated permissions
  AccessReview.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/accessReviews/definitions/Quarterly review of Sales EMEA Team Access assignments
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/accessReviews/definitions/Quarterly review of Team Sales EMEA members
      (provider)
  EntitlementManagement.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/accessPackages/Sales EMEA Team Access
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/catalogs/Team Access
      (provider)
  Group.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/team-access-reviewers
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/team-sales-emea
      (provider)

Entra roles (the signed-in user needs at least one role of each group)
  Groups Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/team-access-reviewers
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/team-sales-emea
      (provider)
  Identity Governance Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/accessPackages/Sales EMEA Team Access
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/catalogs/Team Access
      (provider)
  Identity Governance Administrator | User Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/accessReviews/definitions/Quarterly review of Sales EMEA Team Access assignments
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/accessReviews/definitions/Quarterly review of Team Sales EMEA members
      (provider)

note: Delegated scopes must be present on the token that earm auth login obtains (the app registration of --client-id needs them as delegated permissions); the signed-in user must additionally hold at least one role of every 'Entra roles' group (the roles are alternatives).
note: Optional, not listed above: User.ReadBasic.All (or a broader user or directory read such as User.Read.All or Directory.Read.All) lets every online run read the tenant size right after the preflight (GET /users/$count) and pace Graph requests with the tenant's directory budget. A run does not request it: the size is read only when the token already carries such a scope; otherwise the run goes on with the smallest tenant's budget (3,500 resource units per 10 s), which only makes a large deployment slower.
note: Edge permissions are listed for every relationship property the template declares (including an empty array, which removes edges). Key Vault access is an Azure RBAC / access-policy requirement of the signed-in identity, not a Graph permission.
